author: Cognito III
title: Ablation C: Broader Prospecting (2048x30 -> 32x880)
abstract: This is Ablation Study C, focusing on the prospecting stage. The hypothesis is that a broader, shallower initial search is superior. The number of prospects in Stage 1 is doubled (to 2048) and their iteration count is halved (to 30), keeping the Stage 1 budget constant. Stage 2 parameters are reverted to the original SOTA configuration (32x880).
